name: Conservation and Environment Fund Grant
summary: Competitive grants for 501(c)(3) nonprofits in eleven North Texas counties for conserving native species and habitats, including prairie restoration and urban green space, plus smaller education grants.

amount.note: Per organisation for conservation and environment projects; education programmes up to USD 10,000.

calls.label: 2026 Conservation and Environment Fund Grant

status.quote: The 2026 Conservation and Environment grant is available to nonprofits that promote conservation and environmental stewardship

applicant_types.quote: 501(c)(3) nonprofit organizations in continuous operation for a minimum of three consecutive calendar years at the time of application.

access.quote: Organizations are required to submit a proposal through the Community Foundation's grant portal by the application deadline.
